info.name: API Test Tool
info.description: Covers every endpoint and feature of lbrenman/api-test-tool. Set {{authMode}} in the environment to match the server's AUTH_MODE; the collection pre-request script authenticates /v1 calls. Generated by scripts/build-postman.js.

exec: // Applies the auth mode in {{authMode}} to /v1 requests, SOAP POSTs, SSE streams, /graphql and OData. Requests with header X-Skip-Auth: 1 go out unauthenticated.

const isApi = (p.indexOf('/v1/') === 0 && p.indexOf('/v1/files/presigned/') !== 0) || (p.indexOf('/soap/') === 0 && pm.request.method === 'POST') || p.indexOf('/sse/') === 0 || p === '/graphql' || (p.indexOf('/odata/v4/') === 0 && p !== '/odata/v4/' && p !== '/odata/v4/$metadata');
const set = (k, v) => pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: k, value: v });
if ((pm.environment.get('apiKeyIn') || 'header') === 'query') pm.request.url.addQueryParams([{ key: name, value: pm.environment.get('apiKey') }]);
if (cached && exp > Date.now() + 15000) { set('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + cached); return; }
body: { mode: 'urlencoded', urlencoded: [{ key: 'grant_type', value: 'client_credentials' }, { key: 'scope', value: pm.environment.get('scope') || 'read write' }] },
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error('token request failed', err || res.text()); return; }

pm.test('auth mode reflected', () => { const s = pm.response.json().components.securitySchemes; const m = pm.environment.get('authMode'); if (m === 'none') pm.expect(Object.keys(s)).to.have.length(0); else pm.expect(Object.keys(s)).to.have.length(1); });

pm.test('data API only (no admin or health paths)', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json().paths).filter((p) => !p.startsWith('/v1/') && !p.startsWith('/oauth/') && !p.startsWith('/sse/'))).to.have.length(0));

Query: offset page with nested department

body.raw: {"query": "query($n: Int) { employees(limit: $n, sort: \"id\") { total items { id fullName department { name } } } }", "variables": {"n": 3}}

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data.employees; pm.test('three items', () => pm.expect(d.items.length).to.eql(3)); pm.test('nested', () => pm.expect(d.items[0].department.name).to.be.a('string'));

body.raw: {"query": "{ productsConnection(first: 2) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id } } }", "variables": {}}

exec: const c = pm.response.json().data.productsConnection; pm.test('ids 1,2', () => pm.expect(c.nodes.map((n) => n.id)).to.eql([1, 2])); pm.test('more pages', () => pm.expect(c.pageInfo.hasNextPage).to.eql(true)); pm.environment.set('gqlCursor', c.pageInfo.endCursor);

body.raw: {"query": "query($after: String) { productsConnection(first: 2, after: $after) { nodes { id } pageInfo { hasPreviousPage } } }", "variables": {"after": "{{gqlCursor}}"}}
{"query": "{ employees(limit: 50, filter: [{ field: \"level\", value: \"L3\" }], sort: \"-salary\") { items { level salary } } }", "variables": {}}

exec: const it = pm.response.json().data.employees.items; pm.test('all L3', () => pm.expect(it.every((e) => e.level === 'L3')).to.eql(true)); pm.test('sorted', () => pm.expect(it.map((e) => e.salary)).to.eql(it.map((e) => e.salary).sort((a, b) => b - a)));

{"query": "mutation($id: Int!) { updateDepartment(id: $id, input: { name: \"GraphQL Renamed\" }) { name code } }", "variables": {"id": {{gqlDeptId}}}}

exec: pm.test('renamed, code kept', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.updateDepartment).to.eql({ name: 'GraphQL Renamed', code: 'GQL-PM' }));

const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('data kept', () => pm.expect(b.data.employees.items.length).to.eql(2)); pm.test('department nulled', () => pm.expect(b.data.employees.items[0].department).to.eql(null)); pm.test('two errors', () => pm.expect(b.errors.length).to.eql(2));

item.name: S3-compatible API

exec: const m = /<NextContinuationToken>([^<]+)</.exec(pm.response.text()); pm.test('continuation token', () => pm.expect(m).to.not.eql(null)); pm.environment.set('s3Token', m ? m[1] : '');

body.raw: Hello from Postman over the S3 API

exec: pm.test('ETag is the MD5', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('ETag')).to.eql('"' + require('crypto-js').MD5("Hello from Postman over the S3 API").toString() + '"'));
pm.test('body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql("Hello from Postman over the S3 API"));

exec: pm.test('listed with its S3 key', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some((f) => f.s3 && f.s3.key === 'postman/copy.txt')).to.eql(true));
